ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Roof-Raiser
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} came back from the burned town with a sunburnt neck and a dozen roofs behind {PAWN_objective}. The people there call {PAWN_objective} Roof-Raiser, and now so does the colony.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Feud-Breaker
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Two families who had buried each other's sons for three generations shook hands across a table because {PAWN_nameDef} sat between them. Up and down the road they call {PAWN_objective} the Feud-Breaker.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Bridge-Builder
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: There's a bridge in a neighbour's town that takes laden carts again, because {PAWN_nameDef} spent a week up to {PAWN_possessive} knees in the river. They named the bridge after the colony, and the colony named {PAWN_nameDef} Bridge-Builder.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Finder
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} found a neighbour's lost child out in the hills when the child's own people couldn't. The neighbours call {PAWN_objective} the Finder, and they say it the way people say a blessing.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Road-Warden
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} walked an old pilgrim safely to the end of a long road, and the pilgrim's people have a word for that. In the colony it comes out as Road-Warden, and it has stuck.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Friend of the Road
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Whenever strangers camp near the colony, {PAWN_nameDef} is at their fire by the second evening, trading stories for soup. Travellers ask after {PAWN_objective} by now. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Friend of the Road.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Gatekeeper
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: When strangers come up the road wanting to camp, it's always {PAWN_nameDef} who walks out to meet them. Nobody decided that; it just happened. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Gatekeeper.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Daykeeper
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers every day the colony keeps, and sees to it that it's kept properly: the table laid, the words said, the fire lit. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Daykeeper.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Good Neighbour
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: When a neighbour is in trouble, a plague, a fire, a feud, it's {PAWN_nameDef} the colony sends, and {PAWN_nameDef} who goes without complaint. The region calls {PAWN_objective} the Good Neighbour, and means it.
